NRLMSISE-00 numerical core adapted from Brahe 1.7.0, MIT licensed.
Source: https://github.com/duncaneddy/brahe/tree/v1.7.0/src/earth_models

The upstream high-level geodetic, epoch, and global space-weather interfaces
were omitted. OEL supplies its own validated coordinates, time, and weather
inputs. The numerical model and published coefficient tables are preserved.
